---
name: Unit request
about: Ask for a button interaction that does not exist yet
title: "Unit request: "
labels: unit-request
---

**What you press**
(e.g. the Save button on a note editor)

**What should happen**
Motion, and what the finger should feel. One or two sentences, or a link to a clip.

**Where it lives**
Kind of app and screen. Deployment target if it matters.

**Have you seen it done well somewhere?**
Link or app name. Optional.
